evidence: Cic. Att. 2.15.1: ut scrībis, ita videō nōn minus incerta in rē pūblicā quam in epistulā tuā
terms.comment: Cicero answers Atticus so: “as you write, so I see it”. On its own, as a reply, it is Traupman’s.

sources: Lewis & Short: video
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Cicero’s letter checked against the Perseus Latin text.

phrases.latin: ut scrībis, ita videō nōn minus incerta in rē pūblicā quam in epistulā tuā
phrases.english: as you say, I see that things are no less uncertain in politics than in your letter
